lens: Simogo, simulated critical lens — whole-game arc as an album, finale and screen choreography; not Simogo's actual views. Fresh blind review of alpha.200.

strengths.title: One restrained visual grammar survives the move from first pulse to collected song.
strengths.finding: The opening's small cube, black field and thin line remain recognizable in Vacío and the ring journey. The song screen translates earned places into coloured circles and remaining places into dashed circles without enlarging the protagonist.

strengths.title: The album has a designed departure, climax, release and reprise.
strengths.finding: The chapter sequence assigns Tormenta a higher energy floor and Vacío a deliberately low ceiling. Journey finale construction recalls saved chapter notes and timing, then the theme; the later eleven-place finale stages layer entrances, personal notes, a bar of silence, theme and credits. This is strong structural evidence of an authored arc, without establishing the audible result.

issues.finding: The six undiscovered place names on the song screen become difficult to read: their dashed rings remain discernible, while names such as Faros, Cristales and Jardín nearly disappear into the dark ground. This weakens the finale's invitation to the next six places.
issues.remedy: Raise only the unearned labels' text luminance/opacity. Retain the dashed outlines, smaller ring grouping, existing earned colours, music and world.

issues.status: verified source behavior; usability impact untested
issues.finding: After two seconds the Journey finale assigns the entire overlay a click handler that immediately finishes it. The visible 'Explorar a pie' button appears only with the credits. A tap intended to investigate the animated chapter rings can therefore skip the personal reprise before an exit control has been shown.
issues.remedy: Use one small explicit, keyboard-accessible skip/continue control during the reprise, then keep 'Explorar a pie' in the credits. Remove the unlabelled whole-screen skip target while preserving the score, worlds and automatic completion.

evidence.method: Static fresh screenshot inspection with view_image and source reading. No previous panel ratings, README, HANDOFF, PANEL, history, edits to game files, full suites or subagents.

limits: Scores use 0–10 in 0.5 steps and are provisional judgments on the supplied visual/source sample.
Audio is null: no rendered audio was listened to; arrangement code establishes intent and scheduling only.
Sensation is null: still images and code do not establish experienced emotion, timing feel or an actual playthrough.
No screenshot supplied here shows the Journey credits or full eleven-place finale; finale choreography conclusions are source-based.
No browser interaction, keyboard/focus test, contrast measurement or complete uninterrupted playthrough was performed.
